data.name: Hangul Typing Tale
data.detailed_description:
You can learn to type Korean Hangul 한글 under 2 hours!

Learning a language difficult, but this game isn't about learning to understand the language, hence it's not difficult at all ヽ(ヅ)ノ 

It's all about TYPING KOREAN!

Help the Oeguk Princess 외국공주 to type Korean Hangul to fly high and save her Prince 국민왕자 from the evil Drongon! Reach the moon, where they make Tteok together in tent 💗 

🍀 Learn to type Korean letters with your keyboard or on-screen keyboard
🦆 Professor Duck to guide you through the basic of  Korean letters and words!
🍀 10+ chapters to master Korean words & sentences, including numbers, colors, month, foods, common verbs, sentences...many more!

🍁
Mini-games to enhance your reflex with numbers, colors, handwriting...
🍁 Not just birdies, but also insects and mammals will attack you with the best of Korean!

- Vit Corp.
